q: According to the Red Book 2017, unless otherwise stated in the Contract Data, the Works must be insured for:

choices.label: B
choices.text: The amount of the Performance Security

choices.label: C
choices.text: Full replacement value, plus an additional 15% to cover incidental costs such as professional fees, demolition and removal of debris

explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 19.2.1.

q: According to the Silver Book, for what amount must the Contractor insure the Works (unless otherwise stated in the Contract Data)?

choices.label: B
choices.text: Full replacement value, plus an additional 15% of that value to cover costs incidental to rectification (professional fees, demolition, removal of debris)

explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Silver Book 2017, Sub-Clause 19.2.
